mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attendance_rule ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_rule(work_start_time, work_end_time, late_threshold, early_threshold, supplement_valid_hours, full_attendance_days, update_time) VALUES(#{workStartTime}, #{workEndTime}, #{lateThreshold}, #{earlyThreshold}, #{supplementValidHours}, #{fullAttendanceDays}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_rule SET work_start_time = #{workStartTime}, work_end_time = #{workEndTime}, late_threshold = #{lateThreshold}, early_threshold = #{earlyThreshold}, supplement_valid_hours = #{supplementValidHours}, full_attendance_days = #{fullAttendanceDays}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
